capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs relaying Kia documents: 76.1 kWh pack on Light RWD SR.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database 76.1 kWh pack: 73.0 kWh usable (EVKX says 75.0 net).

chemistry.notes: Page says both the 76.1 and 99.8 kWh packs use NMC cells from SK On.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Kia UK spec page: EV9 uses the 800-volt E-GMP system (needs an 800 V charger for max speed).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: 2024 and 2026 EV9 manuals (MV1) describe the same switch plus navigation trigger; nothing shows a change between 2024 and 2027. Requires a battery heater (per-trim equipment not confirmed). Battery-heater equipment on Light is unconfirmed (Kia US shows no heat pump on Light and the manual says conditioning needs a battery heater), so this may not apply to Light.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relaying Kia US EPA documents: the 76.1 kWh pack recharges up to 236 kW. EV Database lists 210 kW for this pack, which looks copied from the 99.8 kWh page. No Kia page states it.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relaying Kia documents: 10.9 kW for both packs.
